brief:
Providence, Rhode Island has become the first U.S. city to pass binding divestment legislation against Israel through a ballot vote, Mondoweiss reported. The measure was approved following a grassroots campaign that supporters say demonstrated strategies applicable to other municipalities across the country.

The vote moves the Boycott, Divestment, and Sanctions movement into new territory at the municipal level, surpassing previous efforts that relied on city council votes or administrative action.
dek: Providence, RI, made history as the first U.S. city to pass binding legislation to divest from Israel at the ballot box. Our victory can serve as a model for divestment campaigns nationwide.
title: Providence becomes first U.S. city to vote for Israel divestment
